$comment: The always-on agent context budget (site-engine#229; ported from hirobius/hds@511209ab527b67a1b68765f0b3122983dc8671a1, which ported ops#292). Every file listed here is loaded by every agent in every session before it reads a line of code: CLAUDE.md and what the loop reads first (AGENTS.md, via ralph/prompt.md). It is the same list as `alwaysOn` in docs/state-surfaces.json, which keeps these files to rules, read order and pointers. maxTotalBytes is the measured size (20677 bytes: CLAUDE.md 9974, AGENTS.md 10703) after the 2026-10-12 cleanup plus 5%, not a round number. Fix a violation by moving history to an on-demand file; raising maxTotalBytes is a deliberate decision about what every future session pays for.
